name: Organic Valley Ghee (Pure Clarified Butter Oil)
whyItWorks: Slowly simmered pasture-raised butter that has been filtered to remove all water, lactose, and casein milk solids. Contains pure short-chain and medium-chain fatty acids, notably butyrate, which serves as the primary fuel source for colonocytes (colon epithelial cells).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use for sautéing chicken, drizzling over white rice, or spreading on toast.
